author: laion
description:
Scientific Summaries
	

22 million original LLM-generated structured summaries of scientific papers, enriched with OpenAlex scholarly metadata, plus 2,110,000 additional Gemma LoRA summaries available separately and not yet included in the search indices. Each paper has an 18-field structured summary covering methodology, key results, claims, limitations, and more. This public dataset includes full paper text for ~5.3 million papers where open-access status has been confirmed --… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/laion/Scientific-Summaries.
